title.en: Tale 4 — The Smell of the Food

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: واحد فقير قعد جنب دكان أكل.
sentences.en: A poor man sat next to a food shop.

sentences.ar: أكل خبزه اليابس وهو بيشم الريحة.
sentences.en: He ate his dry bread while smelling the smell.
The shop owner asked him for money.

sentences.ar: قال: إنت شميت أكلي، لازم تدفع.
sentences.en: He said: you smelled my food, you must pay.

sentences.ar: راحوا عند جحا، لأنه كان قاضي.
sentences.en: They went to Juha, because he was a judge.

sentences.ar: جحا أخذ كيس مصاري وهزه قدام الرجل.
sentences.en: Juha took a bag of money and shook it in front of the man.
He asked him: did you hear the sound of the money?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: صوت المصاري بدفع ريحة الأكل.
sentences.en: Juha said: the sound of the money pays for the smell of the food.
